item.title: Honda HR-V e:HEV Gets Prelude’s S+ Shift, Rugged TrailSport Version In Japan
item.description: The Honda HR-V e:HEV gets a new TrailSport variant in Japan, and we like the rugged touches they made to this vehicle. The post Honda HR-V e:HEV Gets Prelude’s S+ Shift, Rugged TrailSport Version In Japan appeared first on Go Flat Out PH .

item.title: Alpinestars Presents IRGP Year 20
item.description: The drama, action and glory on two wheels will be experienced again this November 20, 21 and 22 at the Tarlac Circuit Hill as the 20th year of the InsideRACING Grand Prix will gather the racing stars in the country for a weekend of epic motorcycle racing. IRGP Year 20 will be presented by Alpinestar
